findings.reason: _memory_lines splits on CRLF/CR/LF only, for entry parsing and line numbers alike; U+2028, U+0085, form feed and vertical tab no longer shift lines or cut a heading.
_MC_CALL keeps a call token (res.json(), (data.json()), x.json( ) unstripped and classify skips it; calls added to the reviewer false-positive corpus.

The anchor is checked with _memory_check_is_link (lstat) before isdir, so a top-level link is unanchored; the bare-name root isfile is removed (the walk judges by name). Comment made precise; a spy test with symlinks shows no outside path is judged by stat.
Bare names compare as exact NFC strings on every OS (no normcase, no case-insensitive root stat), so the same memory.md gives the same report everywhere; documented.
A single-segment drive token is outside_project only with a file name (C:x.md) or a drive root (C:\, D:/); A:B, x:y and Q:what are skipped as prose.

_fence_after is pre-existing in scripts/oaw_common.py (used by markdown_lines before this diff); its contract (same character, at least as long, up to 3 spaces of indent, info string allowed) is pinned by test_c7_fenced_code_is_not_checked and test_unclosed_raw_fences_cannot_swallow_annotations.
Only two callers exist, both in scripts/wiki_sync.py: promote_candidates (its JSON output is byte-golden in test_c15) and memory_check; context_hub has its own parser and does not import it.

_memory_fenced tracks fences across the file with precomputed closers: a fence that closes later hides heading-shaped examples (for promote-candidates too); an unclosed fence still ends at the next entry, as test_c7 pins. Linear time.

Added fixtures: linked memory.md and linked .agents (exit 1, outside the project), a directory at memory.md (exit 1), a linked directory pruned from the walk, and suffixed missing citations (:12, ::Symbol, #L4) still reported. A FIFO is not added: POSIX-only and the same isfile branch as the directory case.

Premise is wrong: example/public-hybrid-demo/.agents/memory.md cites no slash path (only ROADMAP.md and VERSION.json), so nothing is left unanchored; the test now asserts counts.unanchored == 0 to pin that.
A Markdown autolink <path> is unwrapped before the placeholder test; the skip characters (< > { } $ * ? | = @ + % ^ &, controls) and the node_modules/@types example are documented in the guide.
_memory_check_printable escapes every Unicode Cc, Cf, Zl and Zp character, which covers U+061C, U+FEFF, U+2028 and all bidi controls.
MEMORY_CHECK_MAX_BYTES (4 MB) is checked with getsize and enforced again on a bounded read; a larger memory.md exits 1 unread. Findings stay bounded by the tokens of a capped file.
